title: Don't Skip the Baseline: A Controlled Comparison of Dynamic Expert Skipping in MoEs
abstract: arXiv:2610.28369v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A growing body of work proposes dynamic expert-skipping methods for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models that adjust the number of experts activated per token during inference, aiming to preserve model quality while further reducing the number of active parameters. These methods have added calibrated importance scores, inter-expert similarity metrics, or learned per-token allocators in order to identify experts to skip. However, different calibration regimes, different reductions in the effective number of experts, and evaluation suites make comparisons difficult. We classify four representative prior methods into a unified taxonomy and benchmark them against a natural, simple baseline: statically reducing the number of experts $k$ (i.e., same reduced $k$ across all layers and tokens). We provide a fair comparison of these methods at matched expert-compute budget, on two modern MoEs (Gemma4-26B-A4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B) in a text-only setting

translated_title: 不要跳过基线：MoE模型中动态专家跳过方法的受控比较
translated_abstract: 越来越多的研究工作提出了针对混合专家模型的动态专家跳过方法，这些方法在推理过程中调整每个token激活的专家数量，旨在保持模型质量的同时进一步减少激活参数的数量。这些方法通过添加校准的重要性分数、专家间相似度度量或学习式的逐token分配器来识别需要跳过的专家。然而，不同的校准机制、不同的有效专家数量缩减幅度以及不同的评估套件使得这些方法之间难以进行公平比较。我们将四种代表性的已有方法归类到一个统一的分类体系中，并与一个自然、简单的基线进行基准测试：静态地减少专家数量k（即在所有层和所有token中使用相同的缩减后k值）。我们在匹配的专家计算预算下，在两个现代MoE模型（Gemma4-26B-A4B和Qwen3-30B-A3B）的纯文本设置中对这些方法进行了公平比较。
tldr: 本文首次将四种动态专家跳过方法纳入统一分类体系，并在匹配专家计算预算下与“静态减少专家数量”这一简单基线在两个现代MoE模型上进行了受控公平比较。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first controlled, fair comparison of dynamic expert-skipping methods—unified under a single taxonomy—against a simple static expert-reduction baseline at matched expert-compute budgets on two modern MoE models.
